# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large bulk of concatenated call snippets, but the overwhelming majority are **internal operations chatter**: vehicle/loading coordination, driver instructions, crane/dispatch timing, Porter/auto-booking issues, bill-copy handovers, screw-counting between warehouse staff, and repeated duplicate clips. These were excluded.

The genuine **sales/customer-facing calls** are a smaller, recurring set of patterns: inbound rate enquiries for JSW colour-coated roofing sheets, a few outbound tele-calling scripts ("Calling from Crayon Roofing and Structures, do you have any requirement in roofing sheets JSW Steel?"), accessory/custom-size enquiries (gutters, L-flashing, ridges), screw/Tata-fastener orders, a couple of PUFF-sheet and polycarbonate enquiries, one broker/consultant call (PPGL coil, Cochin), one B2B competitor-check call ("Ramani" posing as individual), and payment/billing/GST follow-ups tied to live orders. Honestly, **true discovery-to-close sales conversations are thin** — most "sales" content is rate quoting, stock-checking, and payment/delivery coordination on already-engaged leads. There is no evidence of a scripted consultative sales process; reps mostly react to inbound price questions.

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon Roofing & Structures is a **JSW-focused distributor of colour-coated/Galvalume roofing sheets** based in Manali, Chennai (near Andarkuppam check post). Reps explicitly tell callers: *"நம்மகிட்ட வேற எந்த brand-உம் இல்ல JSW மட்டும்தான்"* [We don't carry any other brand, only JSW].

**Core product — colour-coated roofing sheets, brand ladder (high→low):**
- **Coloron Plus (JSW)** — flagship, 0.47mm / 0.50mm / 0.60mm thickness. Colours: Sky Blue, Off White, Brick Red, Graphite Grey (=Pencil Grey= Dark Grey, same thing), Royal Blue (=Nova/Dark Blue), Mist Green, "Bare"/Silver (non-colour, lower cost).
- **Pragathi (JSW)** — mid-tier, cheaper than Coloron Plus, mainly Sky Blue/Off White, frequent stock shortages mentioned.
- **Radiance (JSW)** — another mid variant, priced slightly above Pragathi.
- **Indradhanush (Asian brand, PPGI — not JSW)** — cheapest option, only 0.45mm, only Sky Blue/Half White. Used as the "least thickness" fallback when customer wants low cost (e.g., car parking sheds).
- **Kalavan/Kalaran Plus** and **L Plus** also referenced in dealer-rate conversations as comparison points against Tata.
- **Galvalume/GL plain (steel bare / silver)** coil-based pricing — tied day-to-day to raw coil cost; reps are candid that this price can't be locked without checking current coil cost.

**Accessories (JSW line):** L-flashing, ridges, patch board, flashing cutter, deep trim, gutters (custom widths), down-pipe. These are **width/diag
